name: Ceingalad

attributes.attribute: the horse of the hero Gwalchmai fab Gwyar
name may mean hard back or durable spine

text: Ceingalad carries the Welsh and Breton hero Gwalchmai fab Gwyar. The name also appears as Keingalet in Breton. French writers record the forms Gringolet and Guingalet. A further Breton variant is Grangalet. The meaning may be hard back or durable spine. Gwalchmai contributes to the romance figure Gawain in English tales and Gauvain in French ones.

okr.objective: Present Ceingalad as the horse of Gwalchmai, list its name forms, and link the hero to Gawain.
